item.title: Week 10: Bills at Jets
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: BUF -8.5 · O/U 50.5 | Model NYJ 33% vs. market 20% | On paper, Buffalo has the edge, with its 9th-ranked EPA per dropback (+0.17) facing a Jets defense ranked 31st (+0.09 allowed), while the Jets counter by fitting the run gaps, where their defense ranks 16th in stuff rate (18% generated). Josh Allen ranks 10th of 31 in EPA per dropback to Geno Smith's 17th of 31, and the x-factor is Khalil Shakir, who averages 4.4 yards of separation (2nd of 76) against a Jets pass defense ranked 31st. The model makes Buffalo the favorite at 67% win probability, driven by the passing matchup (+3.8 points) and rushing matchup (+2.1 points), both toward Buffalo.
